summary: Solowin Holdings filed a Form 6-K disclosing the immediate resignation of director Haokang Zhu and of Chief Financial Officer and Company Secretary Lili Liu, both effective November 3, 2026. The board appointed Wenjie Zhang, previously Head of HR and Administration at Insight Technology Limited, to fill the director vacancy, and named Feixuan Xia, an account manager at wholly owned subsidiaries Solomon JFZ (Asia), Solomon Private Wealth, AlloyX (Hong Kong) and AX Coin HK, as CFO and Company Secretary under a new employment agreement. No terms, advisors or board recommendation were disclosed. The simultaneous departure of both a director and the CFO, with an internal promotion, warrants watching for governance or disclosure friction.
